reason: I’ll punch the stars first to make the sky disc the box will turn.
expectation: I expect a disc with star-shaped openings, though I’m not sure yet how its shadows will look.

alternatives.reason: Lining the box also seems useful, but I want to prepare the star pattern first.

effect: The star disc is ready, so I can attach its spindle.
reaction: The result was straightforward; I’m curious how the shadows will look.
reason: The spindle should let the star disc turn, which directly supports the goal.
expectation: I expect a star disc mounted on a spindle, though it may still need the box and lamp.

alternatives.reason: Preparing the lamp power also seems useful, but I want to finish the turning disc first.

effect: The spindle and disc are now a shadow wheel; it apparently needs more preparation before fitting.
reaction: Straightforward progress; I still want to see the shadows.
reason: I'll prepare the lamp's power connection so the box can illuminate the wheel.
expectation: I expect a switched battery connection for the lamp, not a working projection yet.

alternatives.reason: The lining also prepares the box, but I want to assemble the lamp power first.

effect: The switched lamp supply is ready; the box still needs preparation.
reaction: Straightforward progress, with the shadows still to come.
reason: Lining the theatre box is the only offered combination and should prepare it for the lamp.
expectation: I expect a lined box that reflects light inside; I don't yet know what effect that will have on the shadows.

effect: The lining redirects light toward the star disc while staying clear of electrical contacts; the lamp can now be fitted.
reaction: The explanation makes the lining's purpose clear.
reason: Fitting the LED is the only offered combination and should provide the light source.
expectation: I expect the lamp to be mounted in the box, but it may still need its power supply and shadow wheel.

effect: The lamp is mounted, and its switched supply can now be connected.
reaction: Straightforward progress toward testing the shadows.
reason: Connecting the supply is the only offered combination and should power the lamp.
expectation: I expect a powered, switchable lamp in the theatre; the shadow wheel may still need fitting.

effect: The theatre now has power, so the shadow wheel can be fitted.
reaction: Straightforward progress; I’m ready to see what the wheel does.
reason: Fitting the shadow wheel is the only offered combination and should bring the stars into the theatre.
expectation: I expect the wheel to mount in the powered box, although it may need further work before its shadows can be tested.

effect: The wheel sits between the lamp and opening, so turning it will move the patches of light; the chapter is complete.
reaction: The light-path explanation was satisfying, though I would have liked to see the shadows tested.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the star wheel was most worthwhile: it brought the parts together and explained how the moving light patches work.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lamp supply was straightforward but less interesting on its own.

surprise.text: The lining redirects otherwise lost light toward the disc; I had not known what effect it would have.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary, although several later actions were the only offered combinations.

continue.text: I would continue to see the shadows in action, though this chapter’s mostly prescribed assembly was less engaging than the final explanation.
